caseNameFull: First National Bank in Plant City v. Dickinson, Comptroller of Florida and Camp, Comptroller of the Currency v. Dickinson, Comptroller of Florida
attorneys: Solicitor General Griswold for Camp and Robert S. Edwards for First National Bank in Plant City on the motion.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 393 U. S. 1079.] Motion to enlarge time for oral argument granted and a total of one hour and 40 minutes allotted for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
